lines: His role shrank a bit lately. He played 26% of snaps over the last 3 games, down from 30% on the season, and carries fell to 4.7 per game from 5.4.
Over the last 3 games he saw 2.7 targets per game, a 10% share of the team's targets, and averaged 4.5 PPR points per game.
Week 11 is against the Jets, who allow the 8th-most PPR points per game to RBs. Our projection for him is still only 6.2 PPR.
